feature: hey routes only to real verbs
description: `hexa hey` resolves plain-English requests through a pure routing table that names only verbs hexa has, routes the core verbs, drops the dead ones, says when nothing matches and marks destructive routes.

specs.description: route answers a hexa request from text alone
specs.when: route("grade the architecture") is called
specs.then: it returns Routed::Hexa with command "analyze ." and a non-empty one-line description

specs.description: route answers a non-hexa request with a Shell route
specs.when: route("show me the git status") is called
specs.then: it returns Routed::Shell with command "git status"

specs.description: route does not consult the filesystem
specs.given: no file or directory named nowhere/at-all exists
specs.when: route("harden nowhere/at-all") is called
specs.then: it returns Routed::Hexa with command "harden nowhere/at-all". It does not fail, check the path or return Routed::None because the path is missing

specs.description: route is a pure function of its text
specs.when: route(text) is called twice, in any working directory
specs.then: both results are equal, and calling route creates, changes or deletes no file

specs.description: the table lists the core verbs and each one exists
specs.when: hexa_commands() is read and `hexa <verb and subcommands> --help` is run for each entry, with any argument placeholder left out
specs.then: the list includes the verbs for analyze, loop, go, adr gates, doctor, self-update, harden and memory search, and every --help run exits 0

specs.description: a removed verb in the table fails the check
specs.given: a table entry naming a verb the binary does not have, such as "brain validate"
specs.when: the whole-table check runs against the binary
specs.then: `hexa brain validate --help` fails and the check reports that entry as failing

specs.description: every hexa route the router produces is in the checked table
specs.when: route(text) returns Routed::Hexa(r)
specs.then: the verb and subcommands of r.command, without its trailing arguments, match an entry of hexa_commands()

specs.description: git state requests route to shell git commands
specs.when: route is called with "what's the git status", "show recent commits" and "what changed (diff)"
specs.then: it returns Routed::Shell with "git status", "git log --oneline -20" and "git diff --stat" respectively, never Routed::Hexa

specs.description: requests for removed systems get no hexa route
specs.when: route is called with "validate the brain", "show my inbox", "give me the brief", "run the report audit", "secrets status" and "scheduler status"
specs.then: none of the results is Routed::Hexa with a command starting with brain, inbox, brief, report, secrets or sched

specs.description: no route, and no table entry, names a dead verb
specs.when: route(text) is called and hexa_commands() is read
specs.then: no Routed::Hexa command, and no entry of hexa_commands(), has brain, sched, inbox, brief, report or secrets as its first word

specs.description: the read-only core verbs are routed
specs.when: route is called with "what's the architecture grade", "where does the work stand", "what should I do next", "check every decision's gate", "check my install" and "update hexa"
specs.then: it returns Routed::Hexa with "analyze .", "loop", "go", "adr gates", "doctor" and "self-update --check" respectively

specs.description: verbs that take an argument carry it from the request
specs.when: route is called with "harden src/parser", "bug-hunt src/parser" and "search memory for retry backoff"
specs.then: it returns Routed::Hexa with "harden src/parser" for the first two and "memory search retry backoff" for the third

specs.description: a required argument the request lacks is not invented
specs.when: route is called with "harden it" with no path, or "search memory" with no search words
specs.then: neither returns Routed::Hexa with a harden or memory search command. No path or search words are filled in

specs.description: route arguments always come from the request
specs.when: route(text) returns Routed::Hexa(r) whose command is harden <path> or memory search <words>
specs.then: <path> or <words> is non-empty and appears in text

specs.description: an unmatched request returns None
specs.when: route("make me a sandwich") is called
specs.then: it returns Routed::None

specs.description: hey says when it found no verb
specs.given: a request that route maps to Routed::None
specs.when: `hexa hey "make me a sandwich"` is run
specs.then: it prints that it found no verb, points at `hexa --help` and runs no command

specs.description: hey never runs a nearest guess, even with --yes
specs.given: a request close to a verb name but matching no rule, such as "doctr plz"
specs.when: `hexa hey --yes "doctr plz"` is run
specs.then: no hexa or shell command is run, and the no-verb message pointing at `hexa --help` is printed

specs.description: text that matches no rule always gives None
specs.given: any string with none of the table's trigger words, including the empty string and random letters
specs.when: route(text) is called
specs.then: it returns Routed::None

specs.description: changing routes are marked destructive
specs.when: route is called with "harden src/parser" and "clean up the dev worktrees"
specs.then: it returns routes with commands "harden src/parser" and "dev worktree cleanup", each with destructive: true

specs.description: --yes does not skip confirmation for a destructive route
specs.given: a request that routes to "harden src/parser" (destructive: true)
specs.when: `hexa hey --yes "harden src/parser"` is run and the confirmation prompt is refused
specs.then: it asks for confirmation, and when refused it does not run `hexa harden src/parser`

specs.description: read-only routes are not marked destructive
specs.when: route is called with "update hexa", "check my install" and "what's the git status"
specs.then: the routes for "self-update --check", "doctor" and "git status" all have destructive: false

specs.description: every tree-, git- or install-changing route is destructive
specs.when: route(text) returns a Route whose command starts with harden, is self-update without --check, or is dev worktree cleanup
specs.then: that Route has destructive: true
